summary: Phase 6 DRY-RUN scheduler preview tested end to end. No call was placed: call-now got only a random id with a wrong name and returned 423. New live-API suite tests/test_ai_calling_phase6_api.py passed 16/16. It covers: 401 without auth on seed/plan/preview/reschedule; 403 without CSRF; 403 with a foreign Origin (manual check); seed returns {seeded:15}; plan counts (5 SCHEDULED, 9 SKIPPED, 1 NEEDS_REVIEW at 12:22 IST); preview warning, last_run, fixtures=15, all jobs mode=DRY_RUN with no _id; every expected reason F-O; A/B/C/E/D SCHEDULED; B planned 10:00 the day before, C 10:00 on the interview day, A exactly 24 h before; skipped jobs have planned_at=null; all planned times are in the future and inside 10:00-19:00 IST; plan twice gives the same job count and times_planned+1; reschedule then plan gives old job INVALIDATED/RESCHEDULED and a new SCHEDULED job with reschedule_count=1; reschedule of an unknown or garbage id returns 404; 3 concurrent plans return 200 plus 409s ([409,200,200], [409,409,200], [409,409,200]) with no duplicate (booking_id, booking_key) and the lock released. Full AI suite: 191 passed, 16 skipped (175 + 16 new). Frontend /ai-calling/live: live-locked-banner is visible; live-activate-btn is disabled; dry-run-warning shows the exact text; there is no Call Now and no call-now testid. Seed then plan fills all 5 counts (5/10/5/9/1), and dry-run-last-run shows '11 Nov 2026, 12:24 pm IST by Admin User'. The table lists 15 current jobs with badges, reasons and adjustments. Clicking dry-run-reschedule-* then plan shows the dry-run-invalidated card with RESCHEDULED. The UI sent only POSTs to dry-run/seed, plan and reschedule. /ai-calling/history still lists Raj (Completed, 81 s). DB snapshot is IDENTICAL before and after: ai_calls=1, ai_call_jobs=1, ai_test_candidates=1, audit=2, bb_registrations=0, pipeline_data=0, mode=testing, emergency_stop=true, provider sha 33d78656... unchanged. AI_CALLING_ENABLED="false" in backend .env.

minor.issue: Re-seeding deletes the bookings and inserts new ObjectIds, but the old ai_dry_run_jobs stay. Every seed+plan cycle adds 15 INVALIDATED/BOOKING_REMOVED jobs; there are now 78 jobs, 63 of them invalidated. Preview sorts by status ascending and returns at most 500 (to_list(500)). 'INVALIDATED' sorts before NEEDS_REVIEW/SCHEDULED/SKIPPED, so after about 30 re-seeds the current jobs would be cut off the preview. Fix: in seed_fixtures, also delete_many ai_dry_run_jobs (fixture-only collection), or exclude/limit INVALIDATED jobs separately in preview.

issues: The table is wider than its card (clientWidth 1030 vs scrollWidth 1225). The Reason column is cut off ('INSUFFIC…') and the 'Simulate reschedule' button needs a horizontal scroll. Wrap the candidate/adjustment text or reduce whitespace-nowrap so Reason and the action column are visible without scrolling.
The invalidated card lists every historical plan (63 rows) because of the backend accumulation above. Collapse it, or show only the last run.
The hamburger button overlaps the TEST MODE banner text (this was already there before Phase 6).

action_items: Seed endpoint: also clear ai_dry_run_jobs (fixture-only), or make preview robust to many INVALIDATED jobs. Today the sort by status puts INVALIDATED first and the 500 cap could hide current jobs.
Make the Reason and Simulate-reschedule columns of dry-run-jobs-table visible at 1920 width without horizontal scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: dryrun.py preview: sort([('status',1),('planned_at',1)]).to_list(500) combined with unbounded INVALIDATED accumulation can hide the current plan (see action item).
Fixture D/O times use strftime('%H:%M:00'), which truncates seconds; this is harmless. D's outcome depends on the current IST time; the API test allows both outcomes outside 10:00-17:00.
The 'ineligible' count includes NEEDS_REVIEW (SKIPPED+NEEDS_REVIEW). This matches the UI labels but is worth stating explicitly in the UI.
Lock: the stale-lock comparison uses UTC ISO strings on both sides (now_iso is UTC), so it is consistent. The unique index on (booking_id, booking_key) blocks duplicates even without the lock. Good.
The module does not import the Bolna client or messaging, and no bb_registrations reads were found. Safety looks sound.
test_credentials: Admin User / QAZwsx##123 works. /app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists password 'Admin User', which is outdated and should be updated.
seed_data_creation: Only the dry-run fixture endpoint was used (ai_dry_run_bookings with synthetic=True, replaced on each seed). ai_dry_run_jobs now holds 78 docs (63 INVALIDATED) from the test runs. Nothing was written to bb_registrations, pipeline_data, ai_calls, ai_call_jobs or settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run python3 tests/snapshot_ai_db.py before and after, and check bb_registrations/pipeline_data counts separately (the script does not print them). test_ai_calling_phase6_api.py re-seeds the fixtures and runs plan, which is safe (dry-run collections only). Run it with -p no:xdist so the module fixture is shared. NEVER send a matching confirm_name to call-now. Do not set AI_TEST_ALLOW_PROVIDER_WRITES.
